Summarize a fitted MMN model

Source: R/mmn.R
summary.citommn.Rd

Reports the permutation importance of each data stream: one stream is shuffled across the batch while the others are left intact, and the increase in loss is what that stream contributed.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'citommn'
summary(object, n_permute = 10L, device = NULL, ...)

# S3 method for class 'summary.citommn'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

object

A model created by mmn.

n_permute

Number of permutations per data stream. Default is 10.

device

Device on which to evaluate. Defaults to the device the model was trained on.

...

Additional arguments (currently not used).

x

a summary of a fitted MMN

Value

An object of class "summary.citommn" holding one row per data stream with the increase in loss, its standard deviation across permutations, and the share of the total.

Details

This is the stream-level analogue of permutation importance for a DNN, and is the interpretive tool a multi-modal model admits, since per-feature effects are not comparable across modalities of different kinds. The standard deviation across permutations is reported beside the estimate, because a stream that contributes little can come out negative by chance.
